# Repo-owned inifile-cpp production header

The unmodified `include/inicpp.h`, `LICENSE.txt` and `README.md` come from [Rookfighter/inifile-cpp](https://github.com/Rookfighter/inifile-cpp) commit `7bb1ec3534768e0d1fd9893d01027468b72af5ec`, the former gitlink pin. This fork uses the single header through its own interface target. The original MIT license and author notices remain.

This is a deliberately scoped production-source copy, not a complete upstream tree. Examples, tests and the nested Catch2 gitlink were omitted because the Mac MM7 helper does not compile them. This note is Enroth Continuum metadata.
